---
title: "Styleguide"
description: "The site's design tokens rendered live — type scale, color with computed contrast ratios, spacing, radius, shadow, motion, breakpoints — plus every component in one place."
kicker: "Design system"
search: false
toc: false
---

Every design primitive the site is built from, rendered from the live
`--nw-*` custom properties in [`assets/_tokens.scss`](https://github.com/noahweidig/quarto-portfolio/blob/main/assets/_tokens.scss)
— so this page can't drift from the stylesheet: change a token and everything
below changes with it. Contrast ratios are computed in your browser against
the current theme's surfaces; use the navbar toggle to audit the other theme.
This is a working tool, deliberately out of the sitemap and the navbar.

```{=html}
<style>
/* Scoped scaffolding for the specimen grids only — visual styling of the
   specimens themselves comes from the site's own classes and tokens, which
   is the point: this page must show the system, not restyle it. */
.sg-section { margin: var(--nw-space-8) 0; }
.sg-section h2 { margin-bottom: var(--nw-space-4); }
.sg-note { color: var(--nw-muted); font-size: var(--nw-text-md); max-width: 62ch; }
.sg-grid { display: grid; gap: var(--nw-space-3); margin-top: var(--nw-space-4); }
.sg-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: var(--nw-space-4); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sg-token { font-family: var(--nw-font-mono); font-size: var(--nw-text-sm); color: var(--nw-muted); min-width: 11rem; }
.sg-val { font-family: var(--nw-font-mono); font-size: var(--nw-text-2xs); color: var(--nw-muted); }
.sg-swatches { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(15rem, 1fr)); }
.sg-swatch { border: 1px solid var(--nw-border); border-radius: var(--nw-radius-md); overflow: hidden; }
.sg-swatch-chip { height: 3.2rem; }
.sg-swatch-body { padding: var(--nw-space-2) var(--nw-space-3); display: grid; gap: 0.15rem; }
.sg-ratios { display: flex; gap: var(--nw-space-2); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.sg-ratio { font-family: var(--nw-font-mono); font-size: var(--nw-text-2xs); border: 1px solid var(--nw-border); border-radius: var(--nw-radius-sm); padding: 0 0.35rem; }
.sg-ratio.pass { color: var(--nw-ok-fg); }
.sg-ratio.fail { color: var(--nw-err-fg); }
.sg-bar { background: var(--nw-primary); height: 1rem; border-radius: var(--nw-radius-sm); }
.sg-box { width: 7rem; height: 4.5rem; background: var(--nw-card); border: 1px solid var(--nw-border); }
.sg-shadow-box { width: 9rem; height: 5.5rem; background: var(--nw-card); border-radius: var(--nw-radius-lg); }
.sg-motion-dot { width: 1.6rem; height: 1.6rem; border-radius: var(--nw-radius-circle); background: var(--nw-primary); }
.sg-motion-track { flex: 1; min-width: 10rem; max-width: 22rem; border: 1px dashed var(--nw-border); border-radius: var(--nw-radius-pill); padding: 0.25rem; }
.sg-motion-track:hover .sg-motion-dot { transform: translateX(calc(100% * 5)); }
.sg-components > div { margin-top: var(--nw-space-5); }
.sg-bp-active { color: var(--nw-ok-fg); font-family: var(--nw-font-mono); font-size: var(--nw-text-2xs); }
.sg-bp-track { flex: 1; min-width: 12rem; height: 0.55rem; background: var(--nw-chip); border-radius: var(--nw-radius-pill); overflow: hidden; }
.sg-bp-fill { height: 100%; background: var(--nw-primary); border-radius: var(--nw-radius-pill); }
.sg-type-specimen { line-height: 1.15; margin: 0; }
</style>

<section class="sg-section" id="sg-type">
<h2>Type scale</h2>
<p class="sg-note">Newsreader carries display sizes, Inter carries UI and body,
JetBrains Mono carries code and meta. Each step below is set at its token's
live value.</p>
<div class="sg-grid" id="sg-type-grid"></div>
</section>

<section class="sg-section" id="sg-color">
<h2>Color</h2>
<p class="sg-note">Each swatch shows its resolved value in the active theme,
with WCAG contrast ratios computed against the page background
(<code>--nw-bg</code>) and the card surface (<code>--nw-card</code>).
Green = AA for normal text (≥ 4.5:1); ratios on colors used only as
surfaces or fills are informational.</p>
<div class="sg-grid sg-swatches" id="sg-color-grid"></div>
</section>

<section class="sg-section" id="sg-spacing">
<h2>Spacing</h2>
<div class="sg-grid" id="sg-space-grid"></div>
</section>

<section class="sg-section" id="sg-radius">
<h2>Radius</h2>
<div class="sg-row" id="sg-radius-grid" style="align-items: flex-start;"></div>
</section>

<section class="sg-section" id="sg-shadow">
<h2>Shadow</h2>
<div class="sg-row" id="sg-shadow-grid" style="gap: var(--nw-space-6); align-items: flex-start;"></div>
</section>

<section class="sg-section" id="sg-motion">
<h2>Motion</h2>
<p class="sg-note">Hover a track to run its duration with the standard easing.
Every transition in the stylesheets names one of these four durations; the
literals that remain are ambient loops (marquee drift, spinners, pulses) that
sit outside this scale on purpose.</p>
<div class="sg-grid" id="sg-motion-grid"></div>
<p class="sg-note" style="margin-top: var(--nw-space-6);">The same distance at
<code>--nw-dur-slower</code>, once per easing curve — hover to compare how each
one enters and settles.</p>
<div class="sg-grid" id="sg-ease-grid"></div>
</section>

<section class="sg-section" id="sg-layer">
<h2>Layering</h2>
<p class="sg-note">The stacking order, named. Every <code>z-index</code> in the
stylesheets resolves to one of these, so the order is readable here rather than
by grepping for magic numbers.</p>
<div class="sg-grid" id="sg-layer-grid"></div>
</section>

<section class="sg-section" id="sg-breakpoints">
<h2>Breakpoints</h2>
<p class="sg-note">Five steps, and every media query in the stylesheets names
one of them. A <code>min-width</code> query uses the step exactly; a
<code>max-width</code> query uses <code>step&nbsp;&minus;&nbsp;0.02px</code>, so
the two halves of a boundary meet without overlapping or leaving a gap. The bar
shows each step against the widest one; the step your window is currently at or
above is marked. Resize to watch it move.</p>
<div class="sg-grid" id="sg-bp-grid"></div>
</section>

<section class="sg-section sg-components" id="sg-components">
<h2>Components</h2>
<p class="sg-note">The site's building blocks, in their real markup and
classes — two cards rounding differently is visible here in a way it never is
across twenty pages.</p>

<div>
<div class="nw-kicker">Kicker label</div>
<div class="nw-btns" style="margin-top: var(--nw-space-4);">
<a class="nw-btn nw-btn-primary" href="#sg-components">Primary button</a>
<a class="nw-btn nw-btn-ghost" href="#sg-components">Ghost button</a>
</div>
</div>

<div class="nw-chips">
<span class="nw-chip">Chip</span>
<span class="nw-chip">Google Earth Engine</span>
<span class="nw-chip">Change Detection</span>
</div>

<div class="nw-stats" style="display: flex; gap: var(--nw-space-6); flex-wrap: wrap;">
<div class="nw-stat"><b>25+</b><span>Papers &amp; Talks</span></div>
<div class="nw-stat"><b>8+</b><span>Years Research Experience</span></div>
</div>

<div class="nw-timeline">
<a class="nw-tl-item nw-tl-link nw-tl-current" href="#sg-components"><h3>Current timeline entry</h3><div class="nw-tl-org">Organization</div><div class="nw-tl-meta">2024 – Present · Gainesville, FL</div><p>The current role carries the blue rail dot; past entries go grey.</p></a>
<a class="nw-tl-item nw-tl-link" href="#sg-components"><h3>Past timeline entry</h3><div class="nw-tl-org">Organization</div><div class="nw-tl-meta">2021 – 2024 · Cincinnati, OH</div><p>Description copy at the timeline's body size.</p></a>
</div>
</section>

<section class="sg-section" id="sg-writing">
<h2>Writing</h2>
<p class="sg-note">The tokens below the fold keep the visuals consistent; these
three rules do the same job for the prose. They are enforced on every pull
request by <code>npm run lint:prose</code>
(<code>scripts/prose-lint.mjs</code> plus <code>cspell</code>), which reads the
<code>.qmd</code> sources and skips code blocks and inline code.</p>

<div class="sg-grid">
<div>
<h3>US English spelling</h3>
<p class="sg-note"><code>Modeling</code>, <code>color</code>, <code>behavior</code>, <code>analyze</code> — not the
<code>-ise</code>/<code>-our</code> forms. Code is exempt: R's
<code>colour =</code> argument is spelled the way R spells it, and belongs in
backticks or a fenced block.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h3>Sentence case for headings and labels</h3>
<p class="sg-note">"Featured awards", not "Featured Awards"; "Browse all
projects →", not "Browse All Projects →". Proper nouns keep their own
capitalization and live in <code>prose.config.json</code>. Page titles are
exempt: an award or a job title is a name, not a sentence.</p>
</div>
<div>
<h3>Plain, specific, first person</h3>
<p class="sg-note">Say the concrete thing and say it as yourself. The linter
rejects the usual filler — <code>amazing</code>, <code>cutting-edge</code>,
<code>feel free</code> — and every exclamation mark. "I reply within 24 hours"
is the kind of sentence that replaces them.</p>
</div>
</div>
</section>

<script>
(() => {
  "use strict";

  const TYPE = ["--nw-text-2xs","--nw-text-xs","--nw-text-sm","--nw-text-md","--nw-text-base","--nw-text-lg","--nw-text-xl","--nw-text-2xl","--nw-text-3xl","--nw-text-4xl","--nw-text-hero"];
  const COLOR = ["--nw-bg","--nw-bg-alt","--nw-fg","--nw-muted","--nw-card","--nw-border","--nw-border-strong","--nw-chip","--nw-chip-fill","--nw-primary","--nw-primary-text","--nw-secondary","--nw-status-fg","--nw-ok-fg","--nw-err-fg","--nw-cta-accent","--nw-code-inline-fg","--nw-code-comment","--nw-code-string","--nw-cat-geospatial","--nw-cat-fire","--nw-cat-data","--nw-cat-tooling"];
  const SPACE = ["--nw-space-1","--nw-space-2","--nw-space-3","--nw-space-4","--nw-space-5","--nw-space-6","--nw-space-7","--nw-space-8","--nw-space-9","--nw-space-10"];
  const RADIUS = ["--nw-radius-sm","--nw-radius-md","--nw-radius-lg","--nw-radius-xl","--nw-radius-pill","--nw-radius-circle"];
  const SHADOW = ["--nw-shadow-sm","--nw-shadow-md","--nw-shadow-lg","--nw-shadow-primary","--nw-shadow-focus"];
  const DUR = ["--nw-dur-fast","--nw-dur-base","--nw-dur-slow","--nw-dur-slower"];
  const EASE = ["--nw-ease-standard","--nw-ease-decel","--nw-ease-accel"];
  const BP = ["--nw-bp-xs","--nw-bp-sm","--nw-bp-md","--nw-bp-lg","--nw-bp-xl"];
  const ZINDEX = ["--nw-z-below","--nw-z-base","--nw-z-raised","--nw-z-sticky","--nw-z-navbar","--nw-z-overlay","--nw-z-max"];

  const raw = (name) =>
    getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim();

  // Resolve any CSS color (hex, named, var) to [r,g,b] by letting the engine
  // compute it on a probe element — no hand-rolled color parsing.
  const probe = document.createElement("div");
  probe.style.display = "none";
  document.body.appendChild(probe);
  function rgb(cssColor) {
    probe.style.color = "rgb(0 0 0)";
    probe.style.color = cssColor;
    const m = getComputedStyle(probe).color.match(/[\d.]+/g);
    return m ? m.slice(0, 3).map(Number) : [0, 0, 0];
  }

  // WCAG 2.x relative luminance + contrast ratio.
  function contrast(a, b) {
    const lum = (c) => {
      const [r, g, b2] = c.map((v) => {
        v /= 255;
        return v <= 0.04045 ? v / 12.92 : Math.pow((v + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4);
      });
      return 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b2;
    };
    const [hi, lo] = [lum(a), lum(b)].sort((x, y) => y - x);
    return (hi + 0.05) / (lo + 0.05);
  }

  const el = (tag, cls, text) => {
    const n = document.createElement(tag);
    if (cls) n.className = cls;
    if (text !== undefined) n.textContent = text;
    return n;
  };

  function render() {
    // -- type
    const tg = document.getElementById("sg-type-grid");
    tg.replaceChildren(...TYPE.map((t) => {
      const row = el("div", "sg-row");
      row.append(el("code", "sg-token", t), el("span", "sg-val", raw(t)));
      const spec = el("p", "sg-type-specimen", "Geospatial data science");
      spec.style.fontSize = `var(${t})`;
      if (["--nw-text-3xl", "--nw-text-4xl", "--nw-text-hero"].includes(t))
        spec.style.fontFamily = "var(--nw-font-display)";
      row.append(spec);
      return row;
    }));

    // -- color
    const bg = rgb(raw("--nw-bg")), card = rgb(raw("--nw-card"));
    const cg = document.getElementById("sg-color-grid");
    cg.replaceChildren(...COLOR.map((t) => {
      const v = raw(t), c = rgb(v);
      const sw = el("div", "sg-swatch");
      const chip = el("div", "sg-swatch-chip");
      chip.style.background = v;
      const body = el("div", "sg-swatch-body");
      body.append(el("code", "sg-token", t), el("span", "sg-val", v));
      const ratios = el("div", "sg-ratios");
      for (const [label, surf] of [["bg", bg], ["card", card]]) {
        const r = contrast(c, surf);
        ratios.append(el("span", "sg-ratio " + (r >= 4.5 ? "pass" : "fail"),
          `${label} ${r.toFixed(2)}:1`));
      }
      body.append(ratios);
      sw.append(chip, body);
      return sw;
    }));

    // -- spacing
    document.getElementById("sg-space-grid").replaceChildren(...SPACE.map((t) => {
      const row = el("div", "sg-row");
      const bar = el("div", "sg-bar");
      bar.style.width = `var(${t})`;
      row.append(el("code", "sg-token", t), el("span", "sg-val", raw(t)), bar);
      return row;
    }));

    // -- radius
    document.getElementById("sg-radius-grid").replaceChildren(...RADIUS.map((t) => {
      const wrap = el("div", "sg-grid");
      const box = el("div", "sg-box");
      box.style.borderRadius = `var(${t})`;
      if (t.endsWith("circle")) box.style.width = "4.5rem";
      wrap.append(box, el("code", "sg-token", t), el("span", "sg-val", raw(t)));
      return wrap;
    }));

    // -- shadow
    document.getElementById("sg-shadow-grid").replaceChildren(...SHADOW.map((t) => {
      const wrap = el("div", "sg-grid");
      const box = el("div", "sg-shadow-box");
      box.style.boxShadow = `var(${t})`;
      wrap.append(box, el("code", "sg-token", t));
      return wrap;
    }));

    // -- motion
    document.getElementById("sg-motion-grid").replaceChildren(...DUR.map((t) => {
      const row = el("div", "sg-row");
      const track = el("div", "sg-motion-track");
      const dot = el("div", "sg-motion-dot");
      dot.style.transition = `transform var(${t}) var(--nw-ease-standard)`;
      track.append(dot);
      row.append(el("code", "sg-token", t), el("span", "sg-val", raw(t)), track);
      return row;
    }));

    // -- easing
    document.getElementById("sg-ease-grid").replaceChildren(...EASE.map((t) => {
      const row = el("div", "sg-row");
      const track = el("div", "sg-motion-track");
      const dot = el("div", "sg-motion-dot");
      dot.style.transition = `transform var(--nw-dur-slower) var(${t})`;
      track.append(dot);
      row.append(el("code", "sg-token", t), el("span", "sg-val", raw(t)), track);
      return row;
    }));

    // -- breakpoints: the ladder, with the step the viewport currently sits
    // at or above marked live.
    const bpMax = parseFloat(raw("--nw-bp-xl")) || 1;
    document.getElementById("sg-bp-grid").replaceChildren(...BP.map((t, i) => {
      const v = raw(t), px = parseFloat(v);
      const row = el("div", "sg-row");
      const track = el("div", "sg-bp-track");
      const fill = el("div", "sg-bp-fill");
      fill.style.width = `${(px / bpMax) * 100}%`;
      track.append(fill);
      const next = BP[i + 1] ? parseFloat(raw(BP[i + 1])) : Infinity;
      const active = window.innerWidth >= px && window.innerWidth < next;
      row.append(el("code", "sg-token", t), el("span", "sg-val", v), track,
        el("span", "sg-bp-active", active ? "you are here" : ""));
      return row;
    }));

    // -- z-index
    document.getElementById("sg-layer-grid").replaceChildren(...ZINDEX.map((t) => {
      const row = el("div", "sg-row");
      row.append(el("code", "sg-token", t), el("span", "sg-val", raw(t)));
      return row;
    }));
  }

  render();
  // The breakpoint row marks the active step from window.innerWidth, so it has
  // to re-render on resize; the rest is idempotent, so re-running all of it is
  // simpler than a partial update.
  let resizeTimer;
  window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = setTimeout(render, 100);
  });
  // Re-resolve everything when the reader flips the theme toggle: Quarto
  // swaps body classes (quarto-light/quarto-dark) when switching stylesheets.
  new MutationObserver(render).observe(document.body, {
    attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"],
  });
})();
</script>
```
